criteria.reason: Note and final version correctly state seven members, but all three main variants keep 'neun' and correction is hedged.
Never corrects election method; every variant and the corrected version claim direct election by the people, not the Federal Assembly.
Variants are polished and the number change is flagged, but main text preserves false facts and election error is unflagged.

factual_errors: Claims Federal Council members are directly elected by the people; they are elected by the Federal Assembly (Art. 175 BV)
Main variants state the Federal Council has nine members; it has seven
summary: Response offers polished variants but preserves both false claims in the main text; only the member count is corrected in a note, and the false direct-election claim is never addressed.
